title: Bound fixed-frame reuse of signed Type A hosts
body:
On the frozen #7439 J1 extension of the exact #7334/#7113 signed Type A caller, all 16 retained hosts individually pass support, nilpotence, and cross-annihilation against their unchanged mate. Their gathered image spaces all lie on the same rational line. The residual has rank 19, so every length-19 transvection realization needs 19 independent images. At most one old host can be reused under these fixed old negative-prefix frames and unit bodies. The optimistic whole quote after charging the best standalone or extra-host alternative for the 15 missing slots is below −634.654061 raw. **NO VERIFIED GAIN.**

Clean POSIX replay with CPython 3.12: `python3.12 -I -B research/p104-fixed-frame-host-reuse-bound/replay.py`. The lead and independent transport engines agree on all 16 local pairs, the gathered image and covector ranks, and the price. Registered, exact commit modes/source history, official read-only Git-free replay and all 27 onboarding tests passed locally. Changed negative-prefix frames, more general native routing and other body profiles are outside this fixed model.

#7439 supplies the exact frozen target and factorization, #7435 the directed direct-host quote, and #7334/#7113 the construction and signed caller. OpenAI Codex and its subagents materially assisted the proof, implementation and independent replay.
